condition: Affected GCC floating from_chars routine parses malformed non-NUL-terminated range
assessment: Exact selected PostgreSQL image export examines all1005 actual ELF payloads, including LLVM19, PG extensions and OS utilities. No payload imports any from_chars API and no non-libstdc++ payload defines one. Vulnerable floating APIs are defined only in the installed runtime library, with no current compiled caller. This is a bound-image caller exclusion; it does not assume LLVM absent or copy application-only source arguments to PostgreSQL.
reassess_if: New native extensions, dynamic symbol binding, native payload, architecture or runtime implementation change. Arbitrary operator-added native code is outside the supported reference.
